scheme_name: PM – Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
other_conditions: The household must be an Indian citizen
The household must own a house with a roof suitable for installing solar panels
The household must have a valid electricity connection
The household must not have availed any other subsidy for solar panels
benefits_summary: Provides free electricity by subsidizing rooftop solar installations, with subsidies ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹78,000 based on consumption.
